{{Quote|For years the Empire wanted a piece of my gambling network.|Sollima to Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya]]''</ref>}}
'''Sollima's gambling network''' was a gambling network owned and ruled by an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sollima]]. It has [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] on multiple [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as [[Simbarc]], but its jewel was the [[Hollow Moon]], a gambling world located in the the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt-controlled]] [[Khorya system/Legends|Khorya system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], that hosted all type of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]&mdash;from [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tables to the gladiator rings.

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] wanted to take control over Sollima's gambling network for years, but did not want to start a large-scale conflict in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. So it first acquired [[Sollima]]'s accounting droid to used information inside him against [[Sollima]] and later ordered [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrels]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Billal Batross]] to infiltrate the Moon and disable its security network in exchange for release from captivity. Once they completed the task, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took control over the world, Sollima was captured and his organization was disbanded.
